view_meta: shadow proposals — free-form fixes the agent named with no registered op-class; recorded and screened, structurally unexecutable (spec/026 · TG-228).
purpose: PROPOSALS surface (record domain, epic TG-227/TG-228, spec/026 REQ-2607): the operator window onto the open proposal plane — every free-form remediation the agent proposed where NO registered op-class existed. One honest live table from the read-only GET /v1/proposals (AuthReadOnly, nil-reader 503): external ref, host, alert rule, the proposed op + free-form op_class slug, the screened rationale, the undo sketch, confidence, actor attribution, age, and (TG-307) the derived diagnosis SIGNAL — whether the agent bound a typed claim, whether it cited GROUNDED evidence AGAINST its own root cause (the recorded A2 failure), and how many assertions it could not ground. The signal only; the claim TEXT stays behind the elevated AuthTraceRead gate on /v1/sessions/{ref}/diagnosis, which the row deep-links to. These rows are the RAW MATERIAL of the earned catalog (spec/028 candidate dossiers cluster them); the view renders NO actuation control of any kind — a shadow proposal cannot execute by construction (nil argv, every effect leaf refuses, never-auto floor; REQ-2608), and the surface never pretends otherwise.
notes: Honesty contract: NO fixture — every value is fetched live at view render via the guarded liveGet contract. Unauthenticated shows only the auth gate; a 503 (nil reader / spine unwired) renders an honest unavailable state and an empty spine an honest empty state, never a fabricated row (INV-15). All rendered text is persisted, screen.Scrub-screened data (REQ-2606); no argv, no secret, no key material appears (INV-13). The rail badge shows the REAL total from the API response and stays em-dash until a real count exists — it never invents a number. TG-307: the diagnosis signal is the SERVER's grounded-contradiction answer (core/db.shadowDiagnosisSignal off the same session_triage.diagnosis column the judge scores), never recomputed in JS; a session with no recorded claim renders an honest em-dash, never a fabricated all-clear. No mutating control exists on this surface: no ratify, no dismiss, no execute (the diagnosis cell's deep-link is a plain anchor to a read surface, not a control) — those belong to spec/028's gated write lane, and rendering them disabled here would still be a lie about this plane's capabilities.
